marketing-budget-calculator.formula:
Share_i = weight_i / sum(all weights)
Amount_i = total budget x Share_i
Example: budget 10,000, weights 30/25/10/20/15 (sum 100).
Search = 10,000 x 30/100 = 3,000.
howTo: Enter your total marketing budget for the period.
Set a weight from 0 to 100 for each channel using the number field or slider.
Each channel's amount and percentage share update instantly below its slider.
When the split looks right, note the amounts and plug them into your media plan.
keyFacts: Each channel's share = its weight / total of all weights, multiplied by the total budget.
Weights are normalized, so 30-30-30-30 gives the same result as 25-25-25-25.
A channel with weight 0 gets nothing; a channel with double another's weight gets double its budget.
Re-weight quarterly: past performance should move money toward what converts.
Keep a 5-10% test budget for new channels outside the main split.
This allocator divides money; it does not decide which channels deserve it - your data does.

marketing-budget-calculator.quickAnswer: Enter your total budget and give each channel a weight from 0 to 100. Each channel's amount equals the total budget multiplied by its weight divided by the sum of all weights. With a 10,000 budget and weights of 30, 25, 10, 20, 15, Search ads get 3,000, Social gets 2,500, Email gets 1,000, Content gets 2,000, and Influencer gets 1,500. Weights are normalized automatically, so they never need to add up to 100.
